colcoor.backendBaseUrl.description: API origin only (no path, no trailing slash). Remote VM: https://your-host. Local docker-compose.prod: http://127.0.0.1 (nginx :80). Local uvicorn: http://127.0.0.1:8000.

colcoor.agentMode.description: How to run the main-thread assistant after your message is saved. auto: try Cursor CLI `agent -p` when on PATH, otherwise stub. headless: always run CLI (fails loudly if missing or errors). stub: placeholder reply only.

colcoor.agentExecutable.description: Executable name or absolute path for Cursor headless `agent` (see https://cursor.com/docs/cli/headless). Colcoor prepends ~/.local/bin (and a few common dirs) to PATH because the editor often does not load ~/.bashrc; use an absolute path if yours is elsewhere.

colcoor.agentTimeoutMs.description: Max time in milliseconds to wait for one `agent -p` run (default 5 minutes).

colcoor.agentOutputFormat.description: How Cursor `agent -p` prints stdout (see https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/output-format). stream-json-partial: NDJSON + --stream-partial-output (fine-grained UI streaming). stream-json: NDJSON without partial deltas. text: final answer only (works on older CLI; minimal streaming).

colcoor.includeWorkspaceHintsInAgentProm.description: When true, append optional workspace context (active file path, non-empty selection, git diff) after the authoritative transcript for each `agent -p` run only (see docs/principles.md). Does not change persisted events.

colcoor.promptForCursorCliOnActivate.description: If the Cursor CLI (`agent`) is not on PATH, show a setup hint a few seconds after load (only when agent mode is not stub). Colcoor cannot bundle the CLI; use Colcoor: Set up Cursor CLI or the official installer.

colcoor.conversationAgentTraceOpen.description: When true, the Cursor CLI trace block under each assistant message starts expanded; when false, it starts collapsed.

colcoor.sideChatNotificationsEnabled.description: Show VS Code notifications for new side-chat messages when the side-chat panel is not visible.

colcoor.sideChatMentionNotificationsEnab.description: When enabled, side-chat messages containing @mentions use mention-priority notification wording.

colcoor.sideChatSoundEnabled.description: Play a short sound cue in the side-chat panel for new incoming user messages while the panel is visible.

colcoor.sideChatMentionSoundEnabled.description: Use a distinct mention sound pattern when a visible side-chat message mentions your profile handle.

colcoor.legalTermsUrl.description: Optional URL to your Terms of Service (https recommended). When set, links appear in About, the conversation panel, drawers, and side chat.

colcoor.legalPrivacyUrl.description: Optional URL to your Privacy policy. When set, links appear in About, the conversation panel, drawers, and side chat.

colcoor.legalRefundUrl.description: Optional URL to your Refund policy. When set, links appear in About, the conversation panel, drawers, and side chat.
